CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2633 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 8cb08929c3cee3ea7e1252f95538f3e3b93692ab. Bus nonce: 19426281adf66339d3e838af3fcea571. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 8cb08929c3cee3ea7e1252f95538f3e3b93692ab`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 8cb08929c3cee3ea7e1252f95538f3e3b93692ab` or `Fix review: blocked 8cb08929c3cee3ea7e1252f95538f3e3b93692ab <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 19426281adf66339d3e838af3fcea571`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `8cb08929c3cee3ea7e1252f95538f3e3b93692ab` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2633 8cb08929c3cee3ea7e1252f95538f3e3b93692ab") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2633-19426281`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, round 2, PR #2633 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), group R10-FLOW-ARCH-PLANNER (policy and budget raise, opus). Head 8cb08929c3cee3ea7e1252f95538f3e3b93692ab. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. Use the finder harness per the group brief, never the fixer's. Re-read the head first; if it moved, the verdict is blocked.

Check:
1. The group brief (git show origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json, group R10-FLOW-ARCH-PLANNER) against the diff. It adds 7 role contracts and touches orchestrator.md and CLAUDE.md. Is each change a sound policy change with an owner, and not a restatement?
2. The budget raise: policy_budgets corpus_tokens goes from 62892 to 66443, and new caps are added. The body's `## Raise justification` must record each payment it tried and an `Architecture score: dS` line, per CLAUDE.md rule 2. Try at least one payment yourself: could existing policy text be cut or folded to pay for it?
3. The fast (3.14) fix: dev/audit/harnesses/r10_triage_gate_replay.py uses the canonical repo_root walk. Check that tests/harness_headers.py passes, and that re-inserting parents[3] turns it red.
4. The diff does not edit dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json (git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD).
5. CI at the head: read check-runs. budget-raise-gate is red by design until approval. nightly-status grades main.

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
Round 2: round 1 blocked on a merge conflict in orchestrator.md section 10 (see origin/review/2633). The fixer merged main e45fc34fb and resolved section 10b: it kept a one-line pointer in orchestrator.md and moved #2628's landed wording into standing-roster.md. Verify that no rule #2628 landed is lost or weakened, and that none is stated twice. corpus_tokens was re-recorded at 66507; re-measure it. Every round-1 finding must be answered.
The fixer did not re-run entities.py, env_drift.py, closure.py selftest or layout.py after the merge, but the body cites them at the new base. Re-run each one and treat any stale figure as a finding. The always-loaded figure is 3609 against a 3349 cap; check that the lint band really admits it.
